name: 1-Pentanol
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database

source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 88.1482 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 195.56-588.10 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; ChemSep, as proposal 0009 sets for the components that are not CoolProp fluids (checked against the NIST WebBook where it has data: vapour pressure)
source.measuredCheck: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/python/check_measured.py): 328 measured values from 110 articles, 278.1-403.1 K; median deviation of the articles 0.11 % (within the 1 % tolerance of the engineering report); largest single deviation +0.40 % at 343.1 K (Yang 2006, doi:10.1021/je0600808); docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md
